firstFailureAndRepair.rootCause: All 43 snapshot cases and the native case failed at fixture `git init` with `fatal: unable to access '\\.\\nul': Invalid argument`. The r20 sources set GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL to Node's os.devNull, which is '\\.\\nul' on win32; Git for Windows rejects that path. The same value sat in the implementation's trusted Git reader environment (planner-input-snapshot.mjs), not only in fixtures.
